blog_title: Combed vs Carded Cotton Difference — Rub Test That Reveals Fabric Quality Instantly
caption:
Kaan ke paas ragdo, farak sunaai dega 👂

Combed cotton? Smooth and silent. Carded? Scratchy sound. That's because combed cotton removes short fibers and aligns the rest — softer fabric, cleaner prints, less pilling even after 10 washes.

Before your next bulk order, do the ear rub test. Simple check. Big difference in final quality.

Save this post if you're sourcing blanks for printing 👇
